description: This file defines macros and function prototypes for a testing library used in unit tests, including test execution, assertions, and diagnostics.

methods.name: test_plan
methods.description: Sets up the number of tests to run, should be called before tests begin.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Finalizes testing, prints plan if not already printed, returns exit code.

methods.name: test_skip
methods.description: Skips the current test with a message.

methods.name: test_skip_all
methods.description: Skips all remaining tests with a message.

methods.name: test_msg
methods.description: Prints a diagnostic message to stdout.

methods.name: test_assert
methods.description: Performs a test assertion, returns 1 if success, 0 if failure.

methods.name: check_uint_loc
methods.description: Checks equality of two unsigned integers.

methods.name: test__run_describe
methods.description: Describes a test case, with variadic arguments for details.

methods.name: test__run_begin
methods.description: Begins a test run, returns 1 if starting successfully.

methods.name: test__run_end
methods.description: Ends a test run, outputs results.

methods.name: test__todo_begin
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a TODO test.

methods.name: test__todo_end
methods.description: Marks the end of a TODO test, indicates success or failure.
